named_events.loss_description: Hurricane Matthew, the largest of these storms, is now expected to cost the insurance industry between $2.5bn and $8.0bn, but that will not in itself have a material impact on premium rates. The impact of Hurricane Matthew on syndicate 623 was modest.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded prior year reserve releases in 2016 totalling $40.8m (2015: $40.3m). Management states these arise as uncertainty reduces and margins previously held above actuarial estimates have been released, driven by favourable claims development across divisions (notably specialty lines), resulting in an overall release equivalent to approximately 5.9% of opening gross claims outstanding.
raw_causal_phrases: initial reserves being set to include risk margins that may be released over time as and when any uncertainty reduces.
During 2016, we have been able to release prior year reserves of $40.8m (2015: $40.3m).
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development used the narrative "release prior year reserves of $40.8m" from the Managing Agent's report. The report does not explicitly label that $40.8m as 'gross' in a separate movement table; it is presented as reserve releases by division (table shows $m by division) and is assumed to be gross (insurance liabilities). If this is net of reinsurance, the figure would differ; no alternative explicit gross movement line was found. All amounts are reported in the report's native currency (USD millions).

_claims_triangle.notes: The notes contain gross/net ultimate development percentages and current gross claims liabilities by underwriting year (Beazley managed level and 623 share). However a classic multi-row cumulative development triangle (rows: at end of UW year, one year later, two years later, etc.) with absolute cumulative amounts per development period was not presented in a single table for extraction. The available data includes development percentages and current ultimate estimates and the current gross claims liabilities (Beazley managed level and 623 share).
